node.statement: Cross corner. Restrict w to the coordinate C*-algebras C^U and C^{{j}}; restrictions preserve the non-unital extended t-inclusion bounds, their units map to P_U and P_j, and their projection bases map to (P_k)_{k in U} and (P_j). By lem-maincb-corner-equivalence (applicable since t<=e_sim), the hypotheses dim S^A_{P_k,P_j}=1 say precisely that every k in U is equivalent to j. More directly, lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity, applicable since t<=e_add, gives a linear bijection S^A_{P_U,P_j} -> direct_sum_{k in U} S^A_{P_k,P_j}; hence dim S^A_{P_U,P_j}=sum_{k in U}1=|U|>0 because U is nonempty. Apply lem-maincb-nested-corner-dimension-transport to (P_R,P_U,P_j), using node 1.2 and t<=e_ncd, to obtain dim S^{A_R}_{P_U^R,P_j^R}=dim S^A_{P_U,P_j}=|U|>0. Thus the target cross corner is nonzero.
